missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Спина' is the feminine nominative subject of 'болит'. 'У меня' frames whose back hurts, and 'сильно' intensifies the pain. The default sentence for complaining about back pain.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Спину' is the feminine accusative direct object of 'повредил'. 'На работе' gives the prepositional location. A natural way to report an injury.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Спины' is the feminine genitive after 'массаж', linking the massage to the back. 'Мне' is the dative experiencer of 'помогает'. Common in talk about treatment.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of body part. 'Спиной' is the feminine instrumental showing the part doing the leaning. 'К стене' is the dative goal after 'к'. Vivid for describing posture.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На спине' uses the feminine prepositional 'спине' after 'на' to place the tattoo. 'У меня' frames possession. A clear pattern for things on the body.
Strategic focus: Accusative object in a command. 'Спину' is the feminine accusative object of the imperative 'держи'. 'Прямо' is the adverb of manner. The classic posture instruction.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В спину' uses the feminine accusative 'спину' after 'в' to show where the wind hits. 'Мне' is the dative of the affected person. Idiomatic for a tailwind.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Спина' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Крепкая' is the agreeing feminine adjective and 'очень' intensifies it. A model descriptive sentence.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Спины' is the feminine nominative plural subject of 'устали'. 'После тренировки' is the genitive time frame. Useful for talking about a group's fatigue.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of orientation. 'Спиной' is the feminine instrumental showing which side faces away. 'Ко мне' is the dative goal. A common reproachful expression.
